 Salman Khan Security Threat Truth | Bigg Boss Schedule Change Claims
 Did Salman Khan take a break from shooting Bigg Boss?: Actor seen under tight security amid reports of schedule change after Tiger Shroff shooting
 3 days ago 
 Copy link 
 Following the shooting incident involving actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai, claims began circulating on social media and in media reports that Salman Khan had taken a break from Bigg Boss 20 due to security concerns.
 Rohit Shetty is set to host the show's upcoming Weekend Ka Vaar episode in Salman's absence. However, the claim linking Salman's break to the attack on Tiger Shroff is false.
 Salman had announced his absence before the shooting incident. During the episode aired on Sunday (October 18), he told the housemates that he would miss the next Weekend Ka Vaar due to prior work commitments and a film shoot.
 Salman Khan had announced his break from Bigg Boss before the attack on Tiger. Salman seen for the first time after the attack Salman Khan was seen at a private airport in Mumbai on Tuesday morning, where security appeared tighter than usual. Armed personnel from the Special Protection Unit were deployed with him. Salman's security arrangements have been further strengthened following the threats.
 Took a break amid the shooting of the film 'Monster' 
 Salman Khan is currently busy shooting for his upcoming film 'Monster'. Producer Dil Raju is overseeing the production of the film, which is being directed by Vamshi Paidipally.
 The film is scheduled to be released next year on Eid. Different looks of Salman Khan from the film have also emerged in recent days. It is being reported that senior actor Jackie Shroff, Tiger Shroff's father, is also part of the film.
 Tiger Shroff was attacked on the evening of 18 October 
 Earlier, a shooting incident involving actor Tiger Shroff's car was reported on the evening of 18 October in the Pushpa Park area of Juhu.
 Tiger Shroff was returning home after playing football when three unidentified bike-borne men opened fire at his car. Tiger Shroff remained completely safe in the attack, but his driver was injured. After the incident, Tiger himself drove the car and took the driver to hospital for treatment.
 Threat to kill Salman Khan 
 After the firing incident, Anil Pandit, who was involved in the attack, threatened to kill Salman in a viral audio clip. He said, "Whoever in the film industry works separately from us or works with Salman Khan, we will kill them. This is the first and last warning."
 Salman Khan, listen carefully: we will destroy your entire family. Keep this in mind. If you think that because you have security, nothing will happen to you, we will do something to you that the whole world will remember.
 Tiger Shroff receives police protection 
 Tiger Shroff has been provided police protection following the firing incident. The Mumbai Police Protection Branch has deployed bodyguards to protect Tiger. The local police station has also assigned a police officer and additional personnel to his security.
